finding: Terminal overwrite and duplicate posting are independent faults: ordered-sequence checks alone do not protect terminal monotonicity; durable receipts protect restarts.
reproduce: Run baseline candidate against evaluator-owned fixtures/cases.json
alternative_explanation: A compilation failure is not a semantic mutant kill; selfcheck separately requires every variant to compile.
limits: No HTTP adapter, real payment dispatch, database transaction engine, distributed delivery, fsync/power-loss guarantees, or production secrets.
